title: The Bear Who Wouldn't Say Please: The Key That Opens Every Door!

lines.text: Barnaby the big brown bear stomped his giant paws into the forest bakery!
lines.caps: Barnaby the big *BEAR | stomped his giant paws into the *FOREST | *BAKERY!

lines.text: Hand over the warm cinnamon honey rolls right now! Barnaby bellowed loudly!
lines.caps: Hand over the warm *HONEY ROLLS | right now! Barnaby *BELLOWED | *LOUDLY!

lines.text: Mrs. Badger folded her apron and clicked the glass display counter shut!
lines.caps: Mrs. Badger folded her *APRON | and clicked the display counter *SHUT!

lines.text: Barnaby huffed and puffed, trying to push through, but the latch wouldn't budge!
lines.caps: Barnaby huffed and *PUFFED, | but the pantry latch wouldn't *BUDGE | at *ALL!

lines.text: Little Robin chirped from the counter, Roaring only builds walls, Barnaby!
lines.caps: Little Robin *CHIRPED, | Roaring only builds walls, *BARNABY!

lines.text: Barnaby looked down at his big clumsy paws. He took a breath and whispered...
lines.caps: Barnaby looked at his *PAWS. | He took a breath and softly *WHISPERED...

lines.text: May I please have a honey roll, Mrs. Badger? I appreciate your hard work!
lines.caps: May I *PLEASE have a roll? | I appreciate your hard *WORK!

lines.text: CLICK! The door swung wide open with a warm smile—magic words open every heart!
lines.caps: *CLICK! The door swung wide open— | magic words open every *HEART!

lines.text: Speak with kindness and respect—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: Speak with *KINDNESS | and respect—*SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS Rhymo!
